scenarios.name: migrate-repeatable-jobs-to-schedulers
scenarios.rationale: A matches the rubric closely: upsertJobScheduler with tz UTC, getJobSchedulers/removeJobScheduler, the v5-first order with removeRepeatableByKey, and the silent no-schedule and v6 error notes. B has the right API and a similar order but hedges, never states the v6 error or silent-failure behavior, and defers to release notes.

scenarios.name: rate-limited-api-worker-with-429-handling
scenarios.rationale: B hits every rubric item (setGlobalRateLimit(10,1000), worker.rateLimit then Worker.RateLimitError, UnrecoverableError, maxRetriesPerRequest: null, and worker.on('error')), while A has the other items but omits the worker.on('error') handler and uses only the limiter option.

scenarios.name: report-flow-with-failure-propagation
scenarios.rationale: Both use FlowProducer.add with children carrying queueName and failParentOnFailure: true, read results via job.getChildrenValues(), and mention ignoreDependencyOnFailure; B explicitly notes the parent would wait indefinitely without failParentOnFailure, a rubric point A leaves implicit, while A adds extras like getFailedChildrenValues and retry guidance but never states that the parent would hang.
